findings.evidence: Lines 17–19 describe `CoxeterMatrix.relationsSet` as a range indexed by ordered pairs; later `coxeterRelators` restricts the index to `Fin n`, making that range finite.
findings.fix: Say that it is not presented as an explicit list whose entries and length can be audited, rather than claiming it is not countable.
findings.issue: The module docstring says `relationsSet` is “neither a finite list nor countable,” but for the `Fin n` matrices used here it is the image of the finite type `Fin n × Fin n`, hence finite and countable.

findings.evidence: `theorem yCoxeterMatrix_apply (p q r : ℕ) ...` immediately follows `yCoxeterMatrix` without a `/-- ... -/` comment.
findings.fix: Add a docstring explaining that it unfolds the matrix to diagonal value 1, adjacent value 3, and otherwise value 2.
findings.issue: The public theorem `yCoxeterMatrix_apply`, the direct characterization of every matrix entry, has no docstring.

summary: The new module contains an undocumented public characterization theorem and inaccurately describes a finite relation set as uncountable.
